However W (Nether Blade)'s own spell block defines a second calc besides its active-cast damage: OnHitDamage (NetherBladeAbility/NetherBlade.mSpellCalculations) = NamedDataValue('PassiveBaseDamage', flat 25 at every rank) + StatByCoefficient(coefficient=0.1, no explicit mStat -> defaults to AP id=0 per FormulaInterpreter). Hand-traced: with 100 AP, OnHitDamage = 25 + 0.10*100 = 35 (constant across ranks since PassiveBaseDamage is flat). Curated as a W bonusEffect trigger onAbility (approximated as firing on every ability cast rather than strictly gating the next attack, same documented style as Akali P) -- SkillDamageDb's AttachableSlots already covers Q/W/E/R, not just P, so this attaches correctly. ActiveDamage (existing W hit) left untouched.
